verdicts.reason: A keeps the stacked hierarchy and an even row of pills. Its flaws: the italic subtitle is jammed against 'Saturday 21 June'; the phone floats on the right over dead space on the left; and the URL line is pushed off-centre and crowds the placeholder image box beside it. B uses a two-column split, but the pill row is broken: TASTINGS sits higher than the other two pills and has a different shape. 'Saturday / 21 June' wraps awkwardly, 'Rooftop' is orphaned on its own line, and the phone crowds the cramped left column.
